Case study 01

Aussies Merch.

A long-form promotional email that combines fan-led imagery, a clear discount offer, trust signals and a structured product selection.

Email creativePromotional campaignEcommerce
View campaign artwork ↓Open supplied Figma ↗
BrandAussies Merch
Work shownLong-form campaign creative
Evidence statusCreative verified · metrics pending
01 — Background

What the approved artwork shows.

The supplied Aussies Merch design is a promotional ecommerce email centered on fan merchandise. It leads with an energetic supporter image, introduces a discount code, adds customer reviews and then moves into featured products.

This page documents the visible campaign decisions only. A commercial brief, send data and attributed results were not supplied, so no unsupported performance figures have been added.

Transparent case-study policy

Verified performance screenshots can be added here later. Until then, the portfolio presents the creative without claiming revenue, conversion or engagement outcomes.

02 — Challenge

Keep a long promotion easy to scan.

The visible creative has to hold attention across a long page while balancing an offer, social proof and multiple product categories. The hierarchy therefore needs to stay obvious as the reader moves from the emotional opening into shopping decisions.

01

Lead with energy

A large supporter-led visual creates an immediate connection to the audience.

02

Repeat the offer

The code and discount return at key points so the value is not lost during the scroll.

03

Add confidence

Customer-review blocks provide reassurance before the main product selection.

04

Structure the range

A clean product grid separates categories and maintains a direct path to shop.
